_comment: Source of truth for daily_signals (source, metric) metadata. Documents the rows already carried in snapshots so any client renders/correlates them with no per-metric code. 'aggregation' = how same-day values combine; 'higher_is' is an optional UI hint; 'label_key' is advisory (i18n key). weather.* is live; health.steps is the device-mode stub the phone will populate.
